rules.title: Safety rules
rules.intro: Please read and accept before you post or send messages.
rules.name: Your name (shown to others)
rules.r1: The traveller opens and checks every item. A traveller is personally responsible at security and customs for everything in the bag.
rules.r2: No drugs, weapons, cash, gold or jewellery, prescription medicine, tobacco or alcohol above the personal allowance, fake goods, loose batteries or flammable things.
rules.r3Title: Check the rules of your route
rules.r3: Customs rules are different in every country. Check the rules of your destination, of transit countries and of your airline. Many airlines do not allow carrying items for other people.
rules.r4: Meet in a public place. Do not post your address, flight number or phone number in a listing.
rules.r5Title: Free and at your own risk
rules.r5: Take With only connects people. It is not a courier and does not check items. Carrying is a free favour between users.
rules.age: I am 18 or older and I accept these rules.

safety.title: Safety centre
safety.allowed: Documents, clothes, gifts, toys, books, packaged food, medicine without prescription in its original box.
safety.refuse: A traveller can refuse an item at any time, also at the handover. No reason is needed.
safety.report: Use “Report” on any listing, profile or chat. We review every report.
